svg.title: From indigo to Tyrian purple
svg.desc: Three indigoid dyes at a common scale and orientation. Bromines are highlighted. The woven color swatches illustrate possible hues and are not measurements.
svg.text: One molecular scaffold with zero, one or two bromine substituents.
On wool, 6-bromoindigo can range from blue to purple as dye concentration changes.
Illustrative swatches · Clark & Cooksey, New J. Chem. (1999), doi:10.1039/A808562E
